lines.zh: 缓慢前行，发出低沉的嘶嘶声。
缓慢移动，发出微弱的求救声。

lines.en: Limping forward with a broken leg.

lines.zh: 缓缓走向玩家，露出尖牙。
lines.en: Slowly approaching you, showing sharp teeth.

lines.zh: 四处寻找食物，目光锐利。
咬下尸体的胳膊，流血不止。
lines.en: Bites off a corpse’s arm, bleeding heavily.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，发出嘶嘶警告声。
缓慢踱步，寻找新的目标。
lines.en: Paces slowly, searching for a new target.

lines.zh: 咀嚼腐肉，发出恶心的声音。
lines.en: Chewing on rotting flesh, making gross sounds.

lines.zh: 跑起来时肩膀一高一低。
lines.en: It runs with one shoulder hitched high.
Knees splayed, it hurls itself forward.

lines.zh: 我垂着头，口水滴在砖上。
lines.en: Head hanging, drool drips onto the bricks.

lines.zh: 低头观察地面，寻找食物。
lines.en: Bends down to look for food.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转圈，等血流干。
lines.en: I circle you, waiting for you to bleed out.

lines.zh: 舔自己的伤口，试图止血。
lines.en: Licks its wound, trying to stop the bleeding.

lines.zh: 用干瘪的手指指向前方。
盯紧玩家，露出凶狠的表情。
lines.en: Fixes on you, a fierce expression.

lines.zh: 我站在你视野边上，不动。
lines.en: I stand at the edge of your sight, still.

lines.zh: 转动头部，寻找玩家的身影。
lines.en: Turns its head to find you.

lines.zh: 目光锁定玩家，发出嘶嘶声。
盯着玩家，发出威胁的声音。
lines.en: Stares at you, making a threatening sound.

lines.zh: 用腐烂的手指指向玩家。
lines.en: Points at you with rotting fingers.

lines.zh: 发出低沉的警告声，盯着玩家。
盯着玩家，发出嘶嘶的警告声。
转动头部，寻找玩家的具体位置。
lines.en: Turns its head to locate you.

lines.zh: 用干瘪的手指指向玩家。
lines.en: Points at you with shriveled fingers.
Broken leg, what a way to die!
Salivating at the sight of flesh!
The smell of the corpse is tempting, forward!

lines.zh: 我饿得只剩跑的力气了。
lines.en: I am starved down to nothing but running.
The stench of rotting flesh draws me!
Hunger like a wolf, pouncing on prey!
Hunger drives me to seek prey!
Meat in the air, straight into the smell!
Hitting the wall, pain through and through!
Colliding with wood, a loud sound!
Colliding with a branch, a crackling sound!
Colliding with a stone, teeth broken!
Colliding with a tree trunk, body trembling!
Found a mate, comforting each other!
Found a companion, sharing the kill!
Met a compatriot, comforting each other!
Met a compatriot, warming up together!
Met a mate, spending time together!
Found a companion, warming up together!

lines.zh: 这袋东西馊了，正合我口。
lines.en: This reeking bag suits my taste.

lines.zh: 隔着两条街它就开始跑。
lines.en: Two streets away, it starts to sprint.

lines.zh: 你的味道顺风飘过来了。
lines.en: Your scent rides the wind to it.
It knows the rhythm of living feet.
It only chases the slower one.
It doesn't weave. It charges straight.
A low wall won't save you.
It waits for you to shut the door.
It slams the door until it rattles.
It follows the smell of your blood.

lines.zh: 它的胳膊比你想象的长。
lines.en: Its arms reach farther than you think.
The more you run, the more it wants.
Your flesh is important to me!

lines.zh: 我咬过的人，都跑不动了。
lines.en: Everyone I have bitten stopped running.

lines.zh: 我的牙比你想象的厉害！
lines.en: My teeth are sharper than you think!
One bite, and you will turn too.
Its nails peel back and it still claws.
It butts your jaw with its forehead.

lines.zh: 从街角转出来，我盯上你。
lines.en: Rounding the corner, I've found you.

lines.zh: 碎砖下，我先伸出一只手。
lines.en: Under the rubble, one hand comes out first.

lines.zh: 碎砖下面，我撑起半个身子。
lines.en: Under the rubble I push half my body up.
One comes sprinting from the alley's end.
I stand up out of the rubble.
No one alive on this street.
One whiff of blood and I run.
Burning. My skin is sloughing off.

lines.zh: 从屋顶翻下来，我的踝骨歪了。
lines.en: I dropped off a roof and my ankle bent wrong.

lines.zh: 水里扑腾，我忘了怎么游。
lines.en: Thrashing in water, I forgot how to swim.
The blast took half my face.

lines.zh: 箭杆插在肋上，我照样往前。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my ribs; I still lurch forward.

lines.zh: 紫光烧穿我的胸口，我还在动。
lines.en: Violet light burns through my chest; I still move.

lines.zh: 雷从头顶下来，烧穿了我的肩。
lines.en: The bolt came down and burned through my shoulder.
